name: Leydig Cell Hypoplasia Due to Partial Luteinizing Hormone Resistance
aliases: Partial LH Resistance Leydig Cell Hypoplasia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical and Genetic Diagnostic Criteria for Leydig Cell Hypoplasia

criteria.description: Presence of undervirilization or ambiguous genitalia in 46,XY individuals
Elevated serum luteinizing hormone (LH) with low or normal testosterone levels
Identification of pathogenic mutations in the LHCGR gene indicating partial LH receptor resistance
Testicular hypoplasia or reduced Leydig cell mass on ultrasound or biopsy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Clinical presentation with hormonal profile consistent with LH resistance plus confirmatory genetic testing for LHCGR mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of other causes of 46,XY DSD and androgen biosynthesis defects.
